descriptionHtml:
106.5 × 81.5cm. Plush on top. A liner that saves the foam.

Scafell is an XL orthopaedic dog sofa bed, 106.5 × 81.5cm, with an egg-crate foam base, a plush sleeping surface and a waterproof inner liner. The cover is removable and machine washable.

Most dog beds are not worn out when they go in the bin. They are ruined. One upset stomach at two in the morning, one coat that came in soaked and never dried, and the smell settles into the foam where no wash reaches.

The waterproof inner liner sits between the plush cover and that foam. Everything above it comes off and goes in the machine. Nothing gets through to the part that cannot be washed.

What they get

  • A waterproof inner liner: Accidents and wet coats stop at the liner instead of soaking into the core.
  • A removable machine-washable cover: It goes in the machine following the sewn-in care label.
  • Cushioned sofa-style sides: Raised edges to lean against or rest a chin on.
  • A profiled egg-crate foam base: Profiled foam underneath the plush so a heavy dog is not on the boards.
  • 106.5 × 81.5cm of XL footprint: Sized for a big dog rather than large for a spaniel.

Best for: dogs who have had a bad night before, wet-walk households, and anyone who has binned a bed that was fine and simply smelled.

Why it is worth the money

£165 buys one thing above all else here, so let us name it. Count the beds you have thrown out that were still perfectly solid. The liner is the difference between a bed that survives one accident and a bed that keeps going. Above it sits a plush cover that machine washes, and beneath both an egg-crate base across 106.5 × 81.5cm.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

What plush costs you is hair. It shows more of it than a flat woven fabric, and you will see it between washes. It brushes off and the cover machine washes, but a dark short-coated dog on plush is visible from the doorway.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Shape
XL, one size106.5 × 81.5Cushioned sofa-style sides

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The sides take up part of the footprint. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Easedale shares this footprint but adds a four-sided bolster and a dropped front. Scafell is the one when the problem is mess rather than mobility.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry everything fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Where exactly does the waterproof layer sit?

Between the cover and the foam. The plush surface your dog lies on washes, and the liner underneath is what stops anything reaching the core.

How deep is the foam?

We publish 106.5 × 81.5cm and no depth figure, so we are not going to state one. If depth decides it for you, ask us first.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Buy the one that survives the bad night.
